detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Betrayal in Uzovnica

You have been framed. Now, there’s no turning back. As a highly trained unit stranded in enemy territory, it’s imperative to push over your limit and get out of there ALIVE. Through your journey, you will find out what lead to these unforeseen events.

Bodycam-Infused Horror

The bodycam is still recording, capturing every moment of your assignment. From the mundane... to the supernatural. A.A.U. Black Site combines realistic visuals, found-footage aesthetics designed to deliver an immersive journey through multiple levels.

Finish the Mission

They think you are weak. Prove them wrong. Check every corner and stay alert in this intense first-person gunplay where you are the prime target. Remember, there are not many left in these lands who can watch your six.

20+ Weapons

Explore an array of over 20 weapons, including but not limited to assault rifles, sub-machine guns and pistols. Go tactical or go loud; the choice of loadout is yours.

The initial release includes:

- God’s Chosen (a Demon) - Available at launch

- Guilt Trip - Available at launch
‎

Future scenes will be released over the coming months:

- Beneath the Rotten Sky - Coming soon

- TBD (To be decided)
